overview_description.description:
relayr is a rapidly-growing IoT company providing enterprise middleware and IoT solutions for the digital transformation of industries. As a thought leader in enterprise IoT, relayr enables interoperability through industrial-grade platforms.

Their software enables comprehensive data analytics and management, empowering businesses to create new solutions and revenue streams with data collected from any device, through any connectivity, throughout any IT ecosystem.

product.name: Predictive Maintenance Solution
product.description: A system that uses sensor data and AI to predict equipment failures and optimize maintenance schedules.

product.name: Equipment-as-a-Service (EaaS) Model
product.description: A subscription-based model providing industrial equipment along with maintenance, software, and services for a fee based on usage or performance.

product.name: Subscription Plus Model
product.description: A comprehensive subscription service combining equipment, software, maintenance, consulting, and consumables delivered through vendor-managed inventory.

product.name: SKYLER Rotate
product.description: A predictive maintenance service focused on rotating equipment that combines technology, services, and warranties to reduce unplanned repairs.
